name: @w6w-apps/pdfmonkey
description: Generate PDFs and images from PDFMonkey templates.

w6w.longDescription:
PDFMonkey turns a template designed in its Dashboard or visual Builder into PDFs (or images) generated on demand from JSON data, and this app is the generation half of that loop: create a document from a template and payload, poll or wait synchronously for the rendered file, then fetch, list, update or delete it. Beyond generation, it can look up templates and their published/draft settings, and list the PDF engines an account can render with, so a workflow can confirm a template still exists or pick an engine without opening the dashboard.

Generation is asynchronous by default (create, then poll or use a webhook), with a synchronous convenience endpoint that waits up to 6 minutes in a single request for low-volume or interactive use. Every generated document is available as a lightweight DocumentCard (recommended for status/download checks) or a full Document (adds payload and generation logs) — this app exposes both so a workflow only pays for the heavier read when it actually needs the payload back.
